name: bacteria
description: Academic research toolkit for comparative genomics of bacterial pathogens across genera: Yersinia, Leptospira, Helicobacter, Salmonella, non-tuberculous mycobacteria, and the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex for everything that is method rather than TB-specific data. Genome assembly and characterisation, species and clade identification, core-genome MLST clonality, ab initio mobile-element detection, CRISPR content, strain and isolation metadata, from published research isolates. Genus-specific resources live here alongside the genus-agnostic methods; the pipeline soldered to the group's TB data stack (TBannotator, bdd/actuelle, WHO catalogue, SITVIT) lives in the mtbc plugin instead. Guyeux group (FEMTO-ST).
